description_en: Queries the policy-based routes configured for a VPN gateway instance by calling the DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries接口查询VPN网关实例下配置的策略路由的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-pbr-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1a3kqjiiq9legfx0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnPbrRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
